_comment: Template for the held-out task-corpus mix. Copy to mix-heldout-a1.json, fill in from the
FROZEN corpus, and pass it to freeze_corpus.py with --mix. See mix-declaration-a1.md for
what declaring is and is not allowed to touch.
memory:          one of useful | unnecessary | outdated, per protocol-a1 section 7. All
three must have at least one task, or the run reports an unmet mix
requirement -- which is a result, not something to repair by capturing
relevance:       corpus id -> necessary | support | outdated. A memory absent from a task's
map is irrelevant to that task, which is what gives the delivered-context
discoverability: required for every 'necessary' fact, per section 7b: discoverable means
the fixture contains it, absent means it does not. An advantage on a
discoverable fact measures retrieval efficiency, not supplied knowledge.
The ids below (h01, h02 ...) are the corpus ids freeze_corpus.py assigns in capture order.
The task keys are the held-out tasks of freeze-heldout-a1.md section 1.
declared_utc: FILL IN -- must precede every arm-run
declared_against_corpus_digest: FILL IN -- the row digest freeze_corpus.py reports
